_comment: Where each issuer publishes its complete register, and how to read it.
The dumps themselves are never committed: half a gigabyte compressed for
one country, renewed monthly, and published under the issuer's own terms.
What is committed is this description, so that anyone can reproduce a
sweep from the same source the maintainers used.

registers.notes: Every company on the live register. The 2026-08-01 file carries 5695465 of them, all on exactly eight characters. Dissolved companies are absent, so a prefix with no row is not thereby invalid.
